hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; [ -z "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}" ] || exit 0; if [ ! -d .methodology/shared ] && g=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir 2>/dev/null); then l="$g/methodology-init.lock"; find "$l" -maxdepth 0 -mmin +1 -delete 2>/dev/null; n=0; until (set -C; : >"$l") 2>/dev/null && trap 'rm -f "$l"' EXIT; do n=$((n+1)); [ $n -le 45 ] || break; sleep 1; done; fi; [ -d .methodology/shared ] || GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_SSH_COMMAND="${GIT_SSH_COMMAND:-ssh} -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10" git submodule update --init -q .methodology >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'methodology: git submodule update --init .methodology failed, so the context-budget hook is off in this worktree until it is fixed.'; exit 0; }; command -v python3 >/dev/null || echo 'methodology: python3 is not on PATH, so the context-budget hook is off.'; case "$(git submodule status .methodology 2>/dev/null)" in +*) echo 'methodology: .methodology/ is not at the pinned commit: a pull moved the pin, or a commit was made inside it. Carry any edit of yours to agent-methodology, then run git submodule update .methodology.';; esac; [ -z "$(git -C .methodology status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ] || echo 'methodology: .methodology/ has local edits. Never edit it (AGENTS.md, Working Conventions): carry the change to agent-methodology, then restore it with git submodule update --force .methodology && git -C .methodology clean -fd.'
[ -z "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}" ] || exit 0; f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.methodology/shared/claude/context-budget.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null || exit 0; exec python3 "$f"
